svg.title: Dataflow-only search goes from capturing none of the gain to all of it
svg.desc: Bars show the share of the full joint search's gain captured by a restricted search that learns only the dataflow, or only the tiling. With the original action space dataflow-only search captured nothing; with the per-stage action space it captures more than the whole.

g.text: share of the joint search's gain
dashed outline = original action space solid bar = per-stage action space
All three variants are statistically indistinguishable (paired tests, every p > 0.23): per-stage dataflow choice was the missing capability.

svg.text: Source: experiments/exp5_ablation/results/processed/ (exp5_ and exp5_perstage_ ablation_summary) · share of the joint search's gain over the best single dataflow · n = 5 seeds
